title: Dual Super-Resolution Learning for Semantic Segmentation (DSRL)
mechanism: Segmentation super-resolution and single-image super-resolution streams share an encoder; a feature-affinity loss ties segmentation features to SR features.
adaptation: Label-free SR auxiliary: from 512 px input, reconstruct the native-res crop of pool cells (part is 1200 px) from decoder features with affinity on shared stride-2 features; unlabelled pool trains the SISR stream.
min_experiment: Arm: house PF + SISR aux on labelled + pool cells; baseline: house PF; CV crack relF1@2, E1 relF1@2. Kill if CV n.d. and E1 < +0.02.
evidence: R: >= 2% mIoU on Cityscapes at similar FLOPs; same mIoU at 70% FLOPs.
prior_overlap: Pool MIM and DDeP (reconstruction pretraining) were n.d.; a joint native-resolution SR auxiliary was not run, but shares the risk.

alt_notes.adaptation: Label-free SR auxiliary: reconstruct native-resolution crops (part of the pool is 1200 px) from decoder features, affinity weighted on a dilated crack + gridline band; unlabelled pool cells train the SR stream.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm house PF + SR stream vs house PF; 5-fold CV crack relF1@2 and E1 relF1@2; kill: CV n.d. and E1 < +0.02. About 15 GPU-h.
